name: SunRise
author: RoWey
description: Fly between the saw and normal gravity portal at 12% to stay as mini. Enter the wave portal at 13% and then navigate through the level's gameplay as the mini wave until 26% where you can hold to the ceiling between the spikes right before the ball portal and stay there. Move down into the middle of the screen at 38% and then play through the gameplay as the mini wave until 44% where you can hold to the ceiling between the saw and structure shortly before the ship portal. Fall down into the mini ship portal at 52%. Play the level normally from there. | Hold to the ceiling between the two saws at 80% as the wave to avoid the cube portal. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
